processor_identity.binding_scope: Existing local snapshot content identity, supported by retained download commit/etag metadata. Historical calls used this directory; no historical run-time weight checksum was retrospectively invented.

encoding.encoder_time_base: original stream time_base; prevents default frame-rate clock rounding for nonzero source PTS
encoding.ffmpeg_version: ffmpeg version 7.0.2-static https://johnvansickle.com/ffmpeg/  Copyright (c) 2000-2024 the FFmpeg developers
encoding.movie_timescale: original stream time_base denominator; exact MP4 edit-list clock

primary.weights: equal utterance weight, average two presentation orders
primary.multiplicity: Holm across three primary two-sided paired sign-flip tests
primary.unit: utterance paired; official dialogue cluster percentile bootstrap also reported
primary.technical_missing: retain every item and report category-wise worst/best effect bounds; complete-case sensitivity secondary; no positive claim unless robust to conservative bounds

secondary.family: one Holm family for CLEAN-RECODE three category effects, three category ordinal dose slopes, three category order interactions, V_ONLY correctness and entropy L3-RECODE
secondary.transitions: all category matrices by each order and condition; no outcome-based filtering

source_protocol_reviewed_fields.scoring: seven frozen candidate sequence teacher-forced probabilities and normalized entropy on every planned slot, preserving generation/scoring/parse as separate statuses; no entropy mediation claim

statistic_definition.endpoint_seed: base+100+10*fixed_endpoint_index; independent cluster seed+1; signflip seed+2
statistic_definition.bootstrap: numpy linear percentile, 10000 draws; item equal-weight dialogue ratio bootstrap
statistic_definition.signflip: 100000 two-sided, plus one correction, equality tolerance 1e-14
statistic_definition.incomplete_ITT: report worst/best category bounds, complete-case sensitivity; INCONCLUSIVE if primary contrast contains missing generation

ERI1_role: Historical frozen comparator only; not migrated or modified
cross_experiment_limit: E1 conflict choices and E2 consistent shared-label retention are different outcomes/populations; no shared physical-intensity scale, pooled denominator or arithmetic causal decomposition.
